mechanism: Vedolizumab causes immunosuppression by inhibiting lymphocyte trafficking, increasing risk of opportunistic infections including CMV reactivation, which ganciclovir is used to treat; concurrent use requires careful monitoring for adequate immune reconstitution and ganciclovir efficacy.
action: Monitor for CMV disease progression and ganciclovir efficacy; consider temporary vedolizumab discontinuation if severe CMV infection develops; ensure adequate renal function monitoring as both agents can affect renal clearance.
